section1.subtitle: Frontend Developer & UI/UX Enthusiast.

intro.title: From Passion to Profession
intro.content: Development is not just a job, it is my way of exploring problem-solving approaches. From self-learning to becoming a professional engineer, I enjoy the process of transforming complex logic into smooth user experiences.

techStack.title: Tech Transformation & Full-Stack Vision
techStack.content: Previously focused on Angular, I successfully transitioned to the Vue ecosystem due to strategic adjustments, currently specializing in Vue 3 and Nuxt applications. Not satisfied with just frontend development, I further explored Node.js (NestJS) and Docker containerization, capable of independently building frontend-backend architecture and deployment environments.

experience.title: Project Practice & Product Development
experience.content: Experienced in B2B and B2G development. Focused on building high-complexity management systems and interactive platforms.

passion.title: Open Source Spirit & Continuous Improvement
passion.content: Committed to writing maintainable, highly reusable code. Develop side projects in spare time and publish common components to NPM, using open-source community standards to review and improve technical depth.

section1.quote: Coding is not just about functionality, it is about creating art in logic.

list.description: Focused on frontend development for AI conversational products and enterprise management systems. Responsible for transforming complex AI logic into intuitive conversational interfaces and building scalable backend architectures.
Participated in the development of large-scale government pension systems, focusing on complex form logic processing and legacy system migration.
Served as the lead frontend developer, spanning e-book malls, government tenders, and system maintenance. Capable of maintaining multiple projects simultaneously and switching contexts quickly.
Established a solid foundation in web development through high-intensity training, covering HTML/CSS/JS core concepts and framework basics.

evolution.title: Continuous Evolution 🚀
evolution.content: Technology is a tool for solving problems, and learning is the instinct of engineers. Currently diving deep into WebGL and System Architecture Design.
